# Bundled browser libraries

These files are copied unmodified from npm so the app works offline and needs no build step.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preact-htm.js` | htm (`preact/standalone.module.js`, includes Preact) | 3.1.1 | Apache-2.0 / MIT |
| `marked.js` | marked (`lib/marked.esm.js`) | 18.2.0 | MIT |
| `purify.js` | dompurify (`dist/purify.es.mjs`) | 3.4.17 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| `katex/` | katex (`dist/katex.mjs`, CSS, woff2 fonts) | 0.19.1 | MIT |
